messages.content:
Analyze the following resume text and extract structured information.
Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown formatting.

Resume:
"""
Priya Nair
Kochi, Kerala | priya.nair@example.com

Profile:
Data engineer who builds batch and streaming pipelines for analytics teams.

Technical Skills:
Python, Scala, SQL, PySpark, Apache Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, Delta Lake, Databricks

Work Experience:
Data Engineer II, Swiggy (2021 - Present)
Rebuilt the order-events pipeline on Databricks with Delta Lake, reducing daily compute cost by 38%.
Orchestrated 140 Airflow DAGs and introduced data quality checks with Great Expectations.
Partnered with the pricing team to ship a near-real-time surge pricing feature store.

Associate Data Engineer, Mu Sigma (2019 - 2021)
Wrote PySpark jobs that aggregated retail point-of-sale data for a US grocery chain.
Modelled a star schema in Snowflake used by 60 business analysts.

Education:
M.Sc. Statistics, University of Hyderabad, 2019
B.Sc. Mathematics, St. Teresa's College, 2017

Achievements:
Winner, Swiggy internal hackathon 2022 for a churn-prediction dashboard.

"""

Return this exact JSON structure:
{
  "skills": ["skill1", "skill2", ...],
  "experience_summary": "A 2-3 sentence summary of their work experience",
  "projects": ["Project 1: brief description", ...],
  "education": "Degree, University, Year"
}

Rules:
- skills: extract ALL technical and soft skills mentioned
- experience_summary: summarize roles, companies, and years of experience
- projects: list each project with a one-line description
- education: most recent degree with institution
- If a section is not found, use empty string or empty array
